verdict.rationale: Ramp shows several concrete AI-generated insights/automations embedded in the product: auto-filled receipt memos/categories, AI-matched invoices with GL coding, hotel rate monitoring with rebooking suggestions, and AI-parsed contract intake — all first-party claims of AI surfacing insights/actions from user data. However, these are scattered feature claims rather than a unified 'insights dashboard' or proactive analytics narrative, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of the AI quality itself (community comments focus on UX speed and culture, not AI insight accuracy). Missing for 10: independent verification of AI insight accuracy, a consolidated insights/analytics surface, and user testimony specifically praising AI-generated suggestions.
